ModMetaData.name: [ARY] Automatic Stump Chopping [1.5 - 1.6]
ModMetaData.author: Arylice
ModMetaData.description:
Arylice's Automatic Stump Chopping #arylice #aryasc
Have you ever watched your lumberjacks chop down trees, only for them to leave those annoying stumps behind, and felt that urge to have everything perfectly tidy? You wish they’d just finish the job completely? This mod will solve this issue in an automatic way!
Safe to add, remove and change its custom settings mid-save! You get the following options that you can enable or disable anytime in-game:
* Automatically Designate The Stump For Chopping After cutting down an almost fully grown tall tree, your worker will instantly designate the spawned stump for chopping, which usually makes them chop down the stump right away as it would be the closest next job to do!
* Automatically Designate Blighted Plants For Cutting Whenever your crops become blighted in the future, the blighted plants will instantly designate themselves to be cut down. This means even if the blight spreads to other plants nearby, it will spawn with a cutting job on itself automatically!
* Chopped Tall Trees Have Falling Visual Effect For most tall trees almost fully grown, when they are chopped, there will be a little visual effect of a falling tree (almost like in Stardew Valley, but not really)! This feature is not perfect, but it can be nice to look at! Young and small trees will not have that small visual effect.
You also get Order buttons to chop and harvest more precisely: * Chop only stumps (Stumps of special DLC trees included). * Chop only fully grown trees with a 100% growth (Special DLC trees will not be marked). * Harvest only fully grown crops with a 100% growth.
This mod requires Harmony! DLC are not required, but works well with them nonetheless!
